{{Quote|What do you know of this place?''"<br />"''Well, it's a very powerful nexus of the dark side.|Sarasu Taalon and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
The '''Font of Power''' was a [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force energy]] located on [[Abeloth's planet]] inside [[Abeloth's cave]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> It was also found in the realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]], which was commonly accessed by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] known as the [[Mind Walkers]], who reached the realm by separating their minds from their bodies. The Font of Power appeared as a fountain in an overgrown courtyard.

According to the Mind Walkers, it was tainted by the dark side of the Force and offered limitless power of all of [[Time/Legends|the past and the future]] if drunk from. Both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] were offered the opportunity to drink from the Font of Power, and both declined.<ref name="Abyss" /> Abeloth [[Duel at the Font of Power|brought]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]] to the Font of Power so they could drink from it and become the new [[Son/Legends|Son]] and [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]], recreating the family of Ones who would reshape [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in their image. Vestara was tempted to drink in hopes that their new forms would enable them to defeat Abeloth but Ben convinced her otherwise. When Abeloth grew impatient, Ben opened himself to the Force, shielding himself from the Font's power, instead drawing on the power of all his loved ones throughout the galaxy and attacked Abeloth. Ultimately, he and Vestara were able to destroy the [[Korelei]]-avatar.
